newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures close higher in temporary correction.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures close higher in temporary correction.

text.p: Frozen concentrated orange juice futures settled firmer amid technically-driven speculative buying, dealers said.
Gains were said to reflect a consolidation and not the reversal of a downtrend. Demand remains slack as supplies continue to grow, analysts said.
"This is a lukewarm rally at best," Bernard Savaiko, an analyst with PaineWebber said, adding that the near-term trend is higher.
Savaiko pegged resistance at a gap on the charts between 78.00 and 79.20 cents basis May, and support at 75.50 cents based on the weekly chart.
May settled 1.20 cent firmer at 77.35 cents per lb, having ranged from 77.55 to 76.50 cents. The back months finished 1.50 to 0.25 lower.
Volume was estimated at 3,000 lots compared to Tuesday's official 3,675 lots.
Market sources said a dockworkers' strike at Brazil's key port of Santos provided some psychological underpinning to the market, although actual disruptions to exports were probably minimal.
